title: Jagged Saudi-Arabian Beef Kidney Tagine
description: Fatty, molten, midnight-craving tagine from Saudi Arabia featuring beef kidney, bonito-shaved, and spices for an ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly meal to satisfy any craving.

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear beef kidney until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove kidney from skillet and set aside.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger to skillet and saut7 until onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add cumin, coriander, turmeric, cayenne pepper, salt, and pepper to skillet and stir to combine.
Add bonito flakes to skillet and stir to combine.
Add beef kidney back to skillet and stir to coat with spice mixture.
Transfer skillet to preheated oven and braise at 30015F for 1 hour.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve.
Let kidney rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
